query: SELECT runner.id, name, is_connected, last_seen, COUNT(*) OVER() AS "total_count!" FROM runner INNER JOIN RESOURCES_WITH_PERMISSION_FOR_LOGIN_ID($2, $3) AS resource ON runner.id = resource.id WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND runner.deleted IS NULL AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR name ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%') AND ($5::BOOLEAN IS NULL OR is_connected = $5) AND ($6::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR last_seen >= $6) AND ($7::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR last_seen <= $7) ORDER BY resource.created DESC LIMIT $8 OFFSET $9;
